en.p: For two natural numbers $a$, $b$ that are at most 5, let $A$ be the set of points where the graph of the function $y=a\sin x+b$ defined on the open interval $(0,\,2\pi)$ meets the line $x=\pi$, and let $B$ and $C$ be the sets of points where it meets the lines $y=1$ and $y=3$, respectively. Over the ordered pairs $(a,\,b)$ for which $n(A\cup B\cup C)=3$, let $M$ and $m$ be the maximum and minimum values of $a+b$, respectively. Find the value of $M\times m$. [4 points]
